__NOEDITSECTION__ 
This article lists the default controls used for [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] on the [[Personal Computer|PC]], [[Xbox]], and [[PlayStation 2|PS2]].

When playing on Xbox 360 White is LB and Black is RB.

==Default Controls==
{| class=wikitable style="text-align:center"
! Control !! PC !! XBOX !! PS2 !! Notes
|-
!colspan=5 |
===At All Times===
|-
! Camera Modes
| '''V''' || '''Back''' || '''Select''' ||
|-
! Pause Menu
| '''ESC''' || '''Start''' || '''Start''' ||
|-
!colspan=5 |
===On Foot===
|-
! Look/Turn
| '''Mouse''' || '''Right<br />Stick''' || '''Right<br />Stick''' ||
|-
! Move
| '''W/A/S/D''' || '''Left<br />Stick''' || '''Left<br />Stick''' ||
|-
! Jump/Climb/Block
| '''LSHIFT''' || [[Image:XBox_X.png|25px|X]] || [[Image:PS3 Square.png|25px|Square]] ||
|-
! Crouch/Sneak
| '''C''' || '''Left<br />Stick''' || '''Left<br />Stick''' || Toggle crouch/sneak<br />*On XBox and PS2, you ''click'' down on the left stick
|-
! Run
| '''SPACE'''<br />(HOLD) || [[Image:XBox_A.png|25px|A]]<br />(HOLD) || [[Image:PS3 Cross.png|25px|Cross]]<br />(HOLD) ||
|-
! Sprint
| '''SPACE'''<br />(TAP) || [[Image:XBox_A.png|25px|A]]<br />(TAP) || [[Image:PS3 Cross.png|25px|Cross]]<br />(TAP) ||
|-

| '''LMB''' || [[Image:XBox_B.png|25px|B]] || [[Image:PS3 Circle.png|25px|Circle]] ||
|-

| '''MOUSE WHEEL UP/DOWN''' || [[Image:XBox_White.png|25px|White]] || [[Image:PS3 L2.png|25px|L2]] ||

| '''RMB''' || [[Image:Xbox RTrigger.png|25px|Right Trigger]] || [[Image:PS3 R1.png|25px|R1]] ||

| '''MMB'''<br />(click the mouse wheel) || '''Right<br />Stick''' || '''Right<br />Stick''' || Toggle look behind<br />*On XBox and PS2, you ''click'' down on the right stick

| '''G''' || [[Image:Xbox Up.png|25px|D-Pad Up]] || [[Image:PS3 Up.png|25px|D-Pad Up]] ||
